newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower. [CORRECTED 12:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower. [CORRECTED 12:25 GMT]

text.p: Delhi stocks shed early gains to close lower on Thursday as operators pocketed profits (corrects from covered short positions), more than offsetting buying by foreign investors, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 1.09 points down at 750.02. It had been up 5.61 points in early afternoon trade.
"Operators who pressed short-selling on Monday were seen covering their positions," said Sanjay Mittal of brokers S.R.M. Securities. But a late bout of profit-taking pushed values down.
